title: deno.lock (written for npm:kleur@4.1.4) is older than the import map (npm:kleur@^4.1.5): lockfile 'frozen' (and 'auto' with CI set) fails with LOCKFILE_FROZEN_DRIFT, 'auto' builds with 4.1.5

expect.drift: deno.lock is out of date: npm:kleur@^4.1.5 resolved to 4.1.5, but deno.lock has no entry for it (it locks kleur 4.1.4).
